formData.1.1: Bluhalo is the independent agency advisory and intelligence practice. We help owners and leaders of independent marketing, PR and creative agencies grow profitably, benchmark their performance and prepare for sale or investment. Founded by Spencer Gallagher and Mark Sainthill, we pair hands-on advisory with proprietary data from 196 live engagements and 75 performance metrics, including gross profit margin, revenue per head and utilisation. We also build tools that change how agencies connect, such as The Agency Agentic Collective, the first network where agencies are represented by dedicated AI agents. Our work pairs experienced operators with hard numbers, not opinion.

1.2.long: Bluhalo helps independent agency owners grow profit and value, using real benchmarking data from hundreds of live engagements rather than guesswork or opinion.

1.3.long: Our benchmarks come from 196 live engagements and 75 metrics, so agency leaders compare against reality, not industry folklore.
Spencer Gallagher and Mark Sainthill have run and advised agencies for decades, so guidance is practical and grounded in experience.
The Agency Agentic Collective shows how we help agencies stay visible and competitive as AI reshapes search and referral.
